sources.title: Smart Irrigation System using IoT and Machine Learning
sources.snippet: The Smart Irrigation System is designed to optimize water usage in agriculture using IoT sensors and Machine Learning. By collecting real-time soil moisture data and weather conditions, the system predicts irrigation schedules and automates water distribution, reducing wastage and improving crop yields.
